fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Perimeter Fencing; Vehicle Parking Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the road entrance to the driveway so responders can locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the opening, particularly at night or in low visibility conditions.
• Trim trees and shrubs along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can travel the full length without obstruction.
• Clear overhanging branches along the access drive to maintain vertical clearance for fire apparatus and taller emergency vehicles.
• Designate and mark a turnaround area near the main residence so arriving vehicles can reposition without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Keep the turnaround area free of parked vehicles, equipment, and stored materials at all times.
• Thin dense vegetation alongside the access drive to reduce the risk of fire spreading to vehicles moving along the driveway.
• Maintain a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings on foot without obstruction.
• Keep the vehicle parking area organized so it does not block the access drive or the space in front of either structure.
• If a gate is present at the driveway entrance, install a Knox Box or provide a combination to the local fire department so responders are not delayed at entry.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Mixed Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Tree Cluster; Open Terrain; Long Driveway; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Ground Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Trees; Brush Area
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to increase open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's exterior walls.
• Cut back ground vegetation growing up against the base of the structure.
• Clear brush from the area immediately surrounding the structure to widen the gap between the building and surrounding plant growth.
• Trim overhanging branches from scattered trees near the structure so branches do not hang over the roof or walls.
• Mow or cut low ground vegetation along the length of the driveway to keep it from crowding the travel surface.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches along its full length so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Thin shrubs growing along the driveway edges where they narrow the usable travel width.
• Cut back or remove dense brush in the brush area closest to the structure.
• Thin scattered shrubs near any outbuildings or parked equipment on the property.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from ground vegetation near the structure before dry season.
• Keep the open green space mowed short to reduce the amount of dry grass that can carry fire toward the structure.
